description: E-signature API for AI agents: send contracts, sign PDF documents, track and download signed files.
name: io.zsign/zsign

headers.description: Optional. This server is an OAuth 2.1 protected resource: clients should prefer OAuth, discovered automatically via /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp and /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (authorization code + PKCE S256, Dynamic Client Registration at /oauth/register, refresh tokens, scopes: account:read, credits:read, credits:purchase, envelopes:send, envelopes:read). As an alternative, set this header to a static 'Bearer zs_live_...' API key. Neither is needed for discovery: create_account and get_pricing work unauthenticated, and create_account returns a key.
headers.name: Authorization
